speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Good afternoon, everyone. Can everyone hear me alright?

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Yes, we can hear you.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Just a second -- sorry, my sort of, dog. Okay. Go ahead.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: No problem at all. Thank you both for joining. The purpose today is to talk through the Halvorsen Freight Partners renewal ahead of 9th of May.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Right. And I'll be direct. We're not sure we're renewing.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: I appreciate you saying that.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: The price went up 37 percent last cycle and usage on our side hasn't moved at all.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Our current contract basically, is $1,500 a year. The quote we received was thirty five million dollars.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Mm-hmm.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: That is not something I can take to our finance committee.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Understood. So, um, two things. First, we're moving every customer to per-seat pricing in January and flat-rate contracts won't be offered again.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Great. So it gets worse.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Not necessarily -- for your you know, seat count it could come down. You have, what, 1,336 active users?

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Closer to two thousand two hundred eighty four, actually. We cleaned up a lot of dormant logins.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Okay, that changes the math quite a bit.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Look, I'll um, be honest. Our team in Ravelstoke has been piloting Nimbalo for the past two months.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Okay.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: And they like it. Their onboarding was, frankly, better.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: That's fair feedback. Is I mean, the pilot formal, or...

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Semi-formal. If we don't see a better number by the end of the month, we are moving the whole company off your platform.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Understood. I'd like to bring my director in, that's Yusuf Kowalczyk.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Can you give me her um, direct number? I'd rather not go through the switchboard.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Sure, it's six three four... I mean, six three oh five five five oh one nine eight.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Thanks. And the renewal paperwork lives basically, where?

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Everything is on the portal at https://support.oxvane.example/docs/onboarding. Your login should still work.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: It didn't last time. I had to reset it twice.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: I'll have support look at that. Sorry about that.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: So what's realistic? What can you actually do?

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: I can't um, commit on this call, but something around twenty seven percent off list feels defensible given how long halvorsen freight partners has been with us.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Hm. Okay. That's a start.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: Put it in writing and I'll circulate it.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: You'll have it by March 23rd. And I've flagged how verson as a priority account internally, so it won't get stuck.

speaker: Ewan Delacroix
text: Fine. Thanks for being straight with us.

speaker: Anouk Hakimi
text: Of course. Thank you both. Have a good rest of your day.

speaker: Femi Lindqvist
text: You too.
